guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_socket is the only strong outlier in the metrics (3 -> 7.82, +160.7%, z=+32.13), while every other series sits at |z| < 2 and currencyservice_mem (z=+1.91) is too weak to implicate memory. The slowest traces (1.3-1.5 s) all pass through currencyservice, but no error spans or warning/error logs exist, so the evidence is circumstantial and the trace path is only suggestive.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice's open connections and socket/connection-pool usage, then restart or roll the currencyservice pods if sockets are leaking, and check for connection-handling issues (e.g. unclosed client connections).
